_comment: DEMO DATA. These entries are FAKE accounts invented for the FinanciLab Payment Guard demo (verified not to exist on testnet as of 2026-11-11). In production this list would come from community reports (e.g. Blockchain Nicaragua / FinanciLab users) with evidence links and review.

entries.reason: Fake BAC prize: asks for NEAR to 'release' a prize (demo entry)
entries.reasonEs: premio falso de BAC: pide NEAR para 'liberar' un premio (entrada demo)
entries.evidence: demo: WhatsApp chain message 'Ganaste un premio BAC, envía NEAR para liberar' reported by FinanciLab users

entries.reason: Fake exchange support account asking users to 'verify' by sending NEAR (demo entry)
entries.reasonEs: falso soporte de exchange que pide enviar NEAR para 'verificar' la cuenta (entrada demo)
entries.evidence: demo: Telegram impersonation of Binance support targeting Nicaragua

entries.reason: Held-remittance fee scam: 'pay a fee in NEAR to release your remittance' (demo entry)
entries.reasonEs: fraude de remesa retenida: 'pague una comisión en NEAR para liberar su remesa' (entrada demo)
entries.evidence: demo: SMS 'Su remesa está retenida, pague la comisión para liberarla'

entries.reason: Crypto doubling scheme: 'send 10 NEAR, receive 20' (demo entry)
entries.reasonEs: esquema de duplicar cripto: 'envíe 10 NEAR y reciba 20' (entrada demo)
